exposure: Multi-strain probiotics (Bifidobacterium longum subspecies infantis plus Lactobacillus acidophilus)
outcome: Abundance of nosocomial pathobionts (e.g., Klebsiella spp.)
Concentrations of B. longum fermentation products (acetate, lactate)
cohort: The study included 175 very-low-birth-weight infants (VLBWIs) with birth weight less than 1,500 g.
finding: Probiotic supplementation was associated with a more beneficial gut microbiome, reduced nosocomial pathobionts, and lower concentrations of B. longum fermentation products prior to sepsis diagnosis, suggesting a potential role in LOS prevention.
followup_time: During the period of highest vulnerability of LOS (specific duration not mentioned)
